description: Replication rights abuse to pull password hashes via MS-DRSR.

telemetry.detail: Directory Service Access - requires object auditing enabled on the domain object (replication GUID 1131f6aa-...). Default OFF.
Not directly visible in Sysmon; only network-layer RPC traffic to DRSUAPI.
DRSUAPI/DRSGetNCChanges call to a DC over RPC; an unusual (non-DC) source host is a strong signal.
Many EDRs and MDI flag non-DC hosts issuing DRSGetNCChanges calls - high fidelity.

prerequisite_privilege: Replicating Directory Changes + Replicating Directory Changes All
abuse_primitive: lsadump::dcsync / secretsdump against a DC for target account hashes.
notes: Score assumes default audit policy (mostly OFF) but high EDR/MDI heuristic coverage. If domain-object auditing is enabled, treat as near-certain detection (90+).
